snippet.title: Catana: Red Flowers | Gameplay Trailer | Ninja by Night, Chef by Day
snippet.description:
Want to try it yourself? 🐱 Sign up for the upcoming CLOSED TEST on Meta Quest:
👉 https://joyway.games/test

The game is growing beyond rooftops and battles with exciting new features:

🍱 Red Flowers Izakaya - cook, serve, and stir up mischief in a cozy yet chaotic place
⏱️ Time Trial challenges - fan-favorite speedrun levels from the Red Flowers Demo
🏃 Flexible locomotion options - switch between STRIDE-inspired parkour and Cat-like movement

And don’t forget to add Catana to your wishlist 🐾
👉 https://www.meta.com/experiences/catana-red-flowers/8996571250452624/
